purpose: One hand-written trade-API-shaped item carrying every modifier array that pob2mcp/bootstrap.lua convert_trade_item normalizes. Each mod line contains its own category marker so a dropped category is visible in the converted item string. Reproduces research finding F12.
not_a_claim: Mod text, base type and values are invented placeholders chosen to be greppable. They are not real PoE 2 modifiers and must never be used as crafting or balance evidence.
shape_source: Field names copied from the arrays that bootstrap.lua convert_trade_item reads (enchantMods, runeMods, implicitMods, explicitMods, fracturedMods, desecratedMods, craftedMods). No live trade response was fetched.
